method: Static traversal of declared property paths through local schema references, array items and tagged structural branches; exact namespace/version conditions gate known profile payloads. No schema validator, semantic validator, project code, operation, test or playback is executed. Example pointers are presence witnesses only. At most six concrete locations per row are retained, with all contributing sample paths. Numeric token precision is not evaluated by this inventory.
limits: Presence does not prove valid ranges, references, ordering, arithmetic, hashes, operations or interchange. Open strings/numbers/vendor data are representative. Invalid counterexamples are described in reference and conformance prose, not counted as positive .ostf samples. Legacy2.3 sources are excluded from stable counts.
